# Site header (web)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: none yet.

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Owns the `SiteHeader` content query (`header`, `headerText`) and its loader for the root layout ([public-site flow](../../flows/public-site/FLOW.md), PS-1). It fails on its own: `null` never affects the sign-in or page queries.

## Techniques

`SiteHeader.graphql.ts` is client-safe; `SiteHeader.server.ts` is `server-only` and builds the query with `defineContentQuery`. `headerText` is a GraphQL alias of the cms-api root field `siteText`. `loadSiteHeader` is in React `cache` and returns `null` with one logged `NO_DATA` error when a root field failed or answered null. Same split as `features/status`.

## Technologies

React (`cache`); `graphql` (dev, in specs).

## Entry points

`loadSiteHeader`, `SITE_HEADER_QUERY` (server file), the types (`SiteHeader.graphql.ts`).

## Where to change what

A new header text: add it to `SITE_HEADER_ROOT_FIELDS`, the type and `SiteHeader.mock.ts` together; `SiteHeader.graphql.test.ts` fails when they differ. Keep the D18 limits.
